verdict.rationale: A government tax agency could plausibly publish bulk public-data extracts or statistics, so the axis applies. The evidence pack contains no such capability: it covers EIN applications, e-file rails (MeF, IRIS A2A), payments, account sign-in and probes, but nothing on downloadable datasets, registry extracts or statistics files.

support.subject: As a developer, the service publishes bulk public-data downloads or extracts (datasets, registry extracts, wage or case statistics) that need no scraping
